title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/FMVSS 108, LOW BEAM HEADLAMP (1,110 affected)
summary: MISWIRING OF THE LOW BEAM HEADLAMP RECEPTACLE FOR THE REPLACEABLE HALOGEN LAMP CAUSES A NONCOMPLIANCE TO FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: UD Trucks Corporation: NISSAN DIESEL/ELECTRICAL (2,933 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS LOCATED TO THE RIGHT OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL AND ROUTED ALONG THE ENGINE TUNNEL TO THE DRIVER'S SEAT BASE CAN CHAFE OR RUB BY CONTACT FROM THE DRIVER'S FOOT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 209, SEAT BELT RETRACTORS (1,573 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITH SEAT BELT RETRACTORS OUT OF DESIGN POSITION WHICH CAN CAUSE THE RETRACTOR TO LOCK-UP ON SLOPES LESS SEVERE THAN THE FMVSS REQUIREMENT.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/PARKING BRAKE CHAMBERS (194 affected)
summary: THE AIR/SPRING ACTUATED PARKING BRAKE CHAMBERS MANUFACTURED BY MIDLAND (DATE CODE 145B6K) WERE FILLED WITH THE WRONG LUBRICATION.  THE IMPROPER LUBRICANT CAUSES THE SEALS WITHIN THE CHAMBER TO FAIL AND RESULTS IN LOSS OF AIR.  IF AIR PRESSURE DROPS TO 55 PSI THE SPRING WITHIN THE CHAMBER WILL AUTOMATICALLY APPLY THE PARKING BRAKE.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: PREVOST/ELECTRICAL (23 affected)
summary: THE GROUND STUDS IN THE ENGINE AND BATTERY COMPARTMENTS DO NOT OFFER ADEQUATE ELECTRICAL CONDUCTIVITY.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: PREVOST/BATTERY CABLE (47 affected)
summary: THE MAIN POWER CABLE CAN WEAR DUE TO FRICTION.

title: DETROIT DIESEL CORP.: DETROIT DIESEL/OPTIMIZED IDLE SYSTEM (1,009 affected)
summary: IF THE IGNITION IS TURNED ON AND THE FUSE FOR THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECM) POWER FEED LINE IS REMOVED OR BURNED OUT, THE SAFETY FEATURES DESIGNED TO PREVENT INJURY TO PERSONS WORKING IN THE VICINITY OF THE ENGINE WILL BE BYPASSED, AND  UNINTENTIONAL CRANKING OF THE ENGINE WILL OCCUR.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BUCKET SEATS (32,596 affected)
summary: THE RECLINER MECHANISM AND THE SEAT FRAME MAY HAVE FOAM AND/OR VINYL VETWEEN THEM, CREATING A "SOFT" JOINT.  THIS "SOFT" JOINT RESULTS IN LOWER THAN SPECIFIED BOLT TORQUE WHICH LEADS TO JOINT LOOSENESS, CAUSING BOLT FATIGUE AND EVENTUAL BOLT FAILURE.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: HOLIDAY RAMBLER/JACK MOUNTING BRACKET (521 affected)
summary: A MOUNTING BRACKET FOR THE OPTIONAL HWH JACK CAN RUB AGAINST THE FUEL TANK WHEN THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/SEAT BELT RETRACTOR (491 affected)
summary: THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR LOCATED NEXT TO THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEATS WILL NOT ALLOW THE BELT TO BE EXTENDED SO THAT IT CAN BE USED.

title: TREK BICYCLE CORPORATION: TREK/BICYCLE CAR RACKS (3,296 affected)
summary: THE SWING ARM OF THE CAR RACK CAN PREMATURELY DISENGAGE CAUSING THE CAR RACK TO FALL FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/TURN SIGNAL SWITCH (171,638 affected)
summary: THESE BUSES HAVE A TURN SIGNAL LEVER THAT WILL NOT OPERATE CONSISTENTLY IN THE LANE CHANGE MODE IF THE LEVER IS NOT MOVED TO THE POSITION WHERE RESISTANCE TO MOVEMENT IS FELT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/DRIVER AIR BAG (742 affected)
summary: TWO BOLTS THAT ATTACH THE DRIVER AIR BAG TO THE STEERING WHEEL WERE NOT INSTALLED DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/ENGINE FIRE (27,500 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH HORTON FAN DRIVES.  THE FAN DRIVE CONTROL SYSTEM WAS RECONFIGURED WHICH RESULTED IN A SIGNIFICANT INCREASE IN THE DEMAND FOR FAN ACTIVATION AND ASSOCIATED STRESS TO ELECTRICAL AND MECHANICAL COMPONENTS.  VARIOUS COMPONENT FAILURE MODELS, COMBINED WITH CHARACTERISTICS OF THE FAN CLUTCH AND ITS BEARINGS, CAN CAUSE FAN CLUTCH BEARINGS TO FAIL PREMATURELY AND RESULT IN A LOCKED FAN.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 301 (432,183 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  4-DOOR, 4-WHEEL DRIVE AND ALL-WHEEL DRIVE MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES.  DURING DEVELOPMENT TESTING, THE PROP SHAFT CONTACTED THE INBOARD SIDE OF THE FUEL TANK ALLOWING FUEL LEAKAGE.  THIS LEAKAGE WAS IN EXCESS OF THE AMOUNT PERMITTED BY FMVSS 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY."

title: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI FUSO/PARKING BRAKE (4,471 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  1994 MODELS ARE ONLY IN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.  THE MATERIAL HARDNESS OF THE PARKING BRAKE RATCHET BAR WAS GREATER THAN THAT OF ITS MATING PART, THE PARKING PAWL.

title: Eldorado National-Kansas: ELDORADO/FRONT STEERING AXLE (45 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH MARMON-HERRINGTON MC80B FRONT STEERING AXLES.  THE LEFT AND RIGHT HAND STEERING ARMS CAN CRACK AND/OR BROKEN DUE TO THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/BRAKE/FUEL LINES (180,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL AND REAR BRAKE TUBES CAN EXPERIENCE ACCELERATED CORROSION BETWEEN THE TUBES AND A RUBBER ISOLATOR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/STEERING WHEEL (675,000 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL ARMATURE STAMPING CAN CRACK AND SEPARATE FROM THE CENTER HUB ATTACHMENT TO THE STEERING COLUMN.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/STEERING COLUMN (475,000 affected)
summary: IF THE PLASTIC PINS AND METAL CLIP THAT RETAIN THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT IN THE UPPER SHAFT BREAK, THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT CAN SEPARATE FROM THE UPPER SHAFT.

title: MONROE AUTO CORP.: MONROE/TORQUE ROD BUSHING (2,808 affected)
summary: AT THE TAPER PIN END OF THE TORQUE ROD IS A METAL AND RUBBER BUSHING.  THIS BUSHING BEGINS TO UNSEAT, OR "WALKS-OUT."

title: MONROE AUTO CORP.: MONROE/TORQUE ROD BUSHING (58 affected)
summary: THE BAR PIN END CAN FAIL.

title: RANSOMES CORPORATION: RANSOMES/CUSHMAN/DOOR LATCH (139 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  3-WHEEL ON-ROAD VEHICLES, MODELS 898464B, 898465A, 898474B, 898474C, 898475A AND 898484.  THE DOOR LATCH CAN RELEASE UNEXPECTEDLY.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/EATON/DRIVE AXLE HOUSING (1,410 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  ALL VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH EATON DRIVE AXLES AND AXILOK SPINDLE NUTS.  THE DRIVE AXLE HOUSINGS CONSIST OF A PLATE STEEL CENTER SECTION AND TWO FORGED SPINDLES, ONE OF WHICH IS WELDED TO EACH END OF THE CENTER SECTION.  EACH SPINDLE CONTAINS A KEYWAY SLOT IN WHICH THE LOCKING TAB FOR THE WHEEL BEARING NUT LOCKING MECHANISM IS INSERTED.  THE LENGTH OF THE KEYWAY SLOT MAY NOT BE LONG ENOUGH TO ACCOMMODATE THE TAB CAUSING THE TAB TO BE DEFORMED OR DAMAGED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/SLIDE-OUT ROOM (241 affected)
summary: THE E-Z SLIDE-OUT ROOM CAN OPERATE UNEXPECTEDLY.  WATER CAN CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT IN THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM CONTROL RELAY.

title: SUPERLIFT SUSPENSION SYSTEMS: SUPERLIFT/BRAKE HOSES (363 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  BRAIDED STEEL BRAKE LINES INCLUDED WITH LKI ENTERPRISES, INC. "SUPERLIFT SUSPENSIONS" BRAKE 4" TO 6" LIFT SYSTEM.  THESE BRAKE LINES ARE INTENDED FOR APPLICATION ON 1988 AND NEWER CHEVROLET, GMC AND OTHER GM LIGHT DUTY TRUCKS, BLAZERS, SUBURBANS, TAHOES, YUKONS AND VEHICLES HAVING A GVWR OF 7300 LBS. OR LESS.  IMPROPER ROUTING OF THE REPLACEMENT BRAKE HOSES CAN RESULT IN THE INSTALLER REFERS ONLY TO THE ILLUSTRATION ACCOMPANYING THE WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS.  ROUTING THE REPLACEMENT BRAKE HOSES UNDER INSTEAD OF OVER THE UPPER CONTROL ARM CAN CAUSE THE BRAKE HOSE TO CONTACT THE UPPER CONTROL ARM AS THE SUSPENSION EXTENDS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/EATON/DRIVE AXLE HOUSING (1,133 affected)
summary: THE DRIVE AXLE HOUSINGS CONSIST OF A PLATE STEEL CENTER SECTION AND TWO FORGED SPINDLES, ONE OF WHICH IS WELDED TO EACH END OF THE CENTER SECTION.  EACH SPINDLE CONTAINS A KEYWAY SLOT IN WHICH THE LOCKING TAB FOR THE WHEEL BEARING NUT LOCKING MECHANISM IS INSERTED.  THE LENGTH OF THE KEYWAY SLOT MAY NOT BE LONG ENOUGH TO ACCOMMODATE THE TAB CAUSING THE TAB TO BE DEFORMED OR DAMAGED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/CRUISE CONTROL (7,633 affected)
summary: THE ECO-CRUISE ACTUATOR CAN BIND THE THROTTLE.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/FRONT IMPACT BEAM (1,040 affected)
summary: THE FRONT IMPACT BEAM INSTALLED ON THESE MOTOR HOMES CAN FALL TO THE GROUND FORWARD OF THE FRONT AXLE.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/ACCELERATOR PEDALS (727 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH THE INTERNATIONAL I6 ELECTRONIC ENGINE AND AN EXTRA THICK BUS BODY FLOOR.  THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL TO FLOOR CLEARANCE IS APPROXIMATELY 1.2 INCHES WITH A STANDARD BUS BODY FLOOR.  HOWEVER, SOME CUSTOMERS ORDERED AN ADDITIONAL 3/4 INCH THICK FLOOR AND EXTRA THICK FLOOR MATS TO SERVE AS INSULATION IN COLD CLIMATES.  WHEN THIS EXTRA FLOORING IS USED, THE BOTTOM EDGE OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL, WHEN DEPRESSED, CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE FLOOR.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/REAR AXLE (233 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES AND HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES PRODUCED BY DANA SPICER.   CERTAIN REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WERE IMPROPERLY HEAT TREATED WHICH  COULD ALLOW PINION BREAKAGE AT THE PINION THREADS.

title: Aston Martin The Americas: ASTON MARTIN/INSTRUMENT PANEL (173 affected)
summary: THE LOW BRAKE FLUID LEVEL WARNING LAMP DOES NOT ILLUMINATE DURING THE IGNITION ON, BULB TEST PERIOD.

title: Aston Martin The Americas: ASTON MARTIN/SEAT BELT WARNING CHIME (173 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SEAT BELT WARNING CHIME DOES NOT SOUND WITH THE SEAT BELT UNBUCKLED.
